info.description: REST contract for the Altium CRM backend. Successful responses return the resource JSON directly (or `{ items, pageInfo }` for collections). Errors use Problem Details (`application/problem+json`) per RFC 9457. Authentication uses an HttpOnly session cookie plus a double-submit CSRF header on mutating requests. CRM business endpoints are not implemented yet.
